patterns.note: The site uses a full-width, dark background with content centered or left-aligned, often featuring large, illustrative elements on the right side of hero-like sections.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established with large, bold, uppercase English headings contrasted with smaller, often green, Chinese subtitles and standard white body text.

A high-contrast palette of deep dark grey/black (#0A0A0A) is consistently used as the background, paired with bright white text and a vibrant, almost neon green (#00FF66) for accent elements and key headings.
No scroll-triggered motion or animations are visible in the provided scroll sequence; the page content remains static.
The 'HISTORY' section is presented as a horizontal timeline with distinct, sharp-cornered green blocks against the dark background, each representing a milestone with a logo and year.

technique_notes: A full-bleed background image with a dark, semi-transparent overlay is used in the hero section to ensure text readability while maintaining a thematic visual backdrop.
The site relies on static content presentation without scroll-triggered animations or parallax effects, maintaining a consistent visual state as the user scrolls.
Intricate, technical line-art illustrations are integrated into sections, positioned to complement text blocks and add a sophisticated, high-tech aesthetic without overwhelming the content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase headings (~3-4x body) are used for primary titles, with smaller, often green, subtitles and standard body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp; all interactive elements and content blocks feature distinct, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; the hero section is particularly airy, while content sections maintain comfortable padding and line spacing.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, dark space-themed background combined with vibrant neon green accents and intricate technical line-art illustrations creates a unique, futuristic, and sophisticated brand identity. The stark contrast and minimalist presentation of complex information, like the timeline, set it apart.
